Affordable Re-Rental Units
PE2- 700 Manida Street

PE2- 700 Manida Street

700 MANIDA STREET

﻿

Comfortable Living in the Heart of Hunts Point

Convenient. Connected. Community-focused.

Discover the convenience of living at 700 Manida Street, located in Hunts Point in the South Bronx. Residents enjoy access to recreation, parks, waterfront destinations, transportation, shopping, dining and community resources—all within the surrounding neighborhood.

RECREATION & GREEN SPACE

Residents are close to Julio Carballo Fields and the Hunts Point Recreation Center, offering opportunities for sports, exercise and outdoor activities.


Nearby Barretto Point Park provides waterfront recreation, open space, playgrounds, sports facilities, picnic areas and seasonal activities.


Hunts Point Riverside Park offers additional waterfront access, a fishing pier, kayak launch and connections to the Bronx River Greenway.


ARTS & COMMUNITY

BronxArtSpace is located at 700 Manida Street, bringing art exhibitions, cultural programming and community activities directly to the building.


The neighborhood is also home to community organizations and programs that provide opportunities for residents of all ages.


GET AROUND THE BRONX & NYC

The location provides access to the 6-subway line, with nearby subway stations connecting residents to Manhattan and other Bronx neighborhoods.

Multiple bus routes also serve the surrounding area, making it easier to travel throughout the Bronx.


EVERYDAY CONVENIENCE

Residents have access to neighborhood supermarkets, grocery stores, delis, restaurants and other everyday services in the surrounding Hunts Point community.


BUILDING AMENITIES

700 Manida Street offers residents convenient on-site amenities, including:

  • Indoor community space
  • Outdoor recreation space
  • Bike storage
  • On-site laundry

Discover Hunts Point

Waterfront Recreation

“Enjoy waterfront recreation, green space and summer activities close to home.”

﻿

  • Barretto Point Park is one of Hunts Point's signature attractions. The waterfront park features open green space, a playground, sports courts, fishing access, picnic areas and the seasonal Floating Pool. It offers residents a unique opportunity to enjoy the East River waterfront without leaving the neighborhood.
Hunts Point Riverside Park & Bronx River Greenway

“Explore the waterfront and enjoy access to the Bronx River Greenway.”

﻿

  • Hunts Point Riverside Park provides access to the Bronx River, with a fishing pier, kayak launch and connections to the Bronx River Greenway. It is an attractive feature for renters who enjoy walking, outdoor activities and access to nature.
Julio Carballo Fields & Hunts Point Recreation Center

“Sports, fitness and recreation just steps from home.”

﻿

  • Baseball field
  • The recreation complex includes baseball fields, basketball courts, a playground, and spray fountain, while the adjacent Hunts Point Recreation Center provides fitness programming and equipment.
  • Hunts Point Recreation Center
The Floating Pool
  • Walking distance to the Hispanic Society Museum & Library.
  • Close to the American Academy of Arts and Letters.
  • Features the colorful Audubon Mural Project throughout the neighborhood.﻿
Hunts Point Landing & South Bronx Greenway
  • Hunts Point Landing is another waterfront destination and part of the area's effort to reconnect residents with the waterfront through the South Bronx Greenway.
Tiffany Street Pier
  • Located next to Barretto Point Park, Tiffany Street Pier provides another opportunity for waterfront views and fishing.﻿
History & Community
  • Joseph Rodman Drake Park & Enslaved African Burial Ground
  • Hunts Point also has a distinctive history. Joseph Rodman Drake Park provides a small green space within the neighborhood.﻿
